items.title: Datadog Sinks 17% in a Week Despite “Strong Adoption Across Our Platform”

items.title: Fortinet Sinks 12% in a Week as the Cybersecurity Selloff Spreads: Is It Time to Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFortinet stock fell 12% in the past week, adding to its post-earnings slide as Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike and Zscaler sold off alongside it. Service revenue grew just 13% in the third quarter while billings grew 29%, and management says big deals are taking longer to activate.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks and CrowdStrike Sink 17% in a Week, Zscaler 18%: Time to Buy Before Earnings?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks fell 17% in a week with CrowdStrike and Zscaler, as a sell-off in AI and chip stocks hit software’s 2026 winners. Palo Alto had no major bad news of its own, so it’s a better buy than a month ago, though its forward P/E is still well above its five-year average.

items.title: What Is Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Signaling With A Seventh AI Security Deal?
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS: PANW) is in advanced talks to acquire Clutch Security, a specialist in securing AI agents. The potential deal would mark Palo Alto Networks' seventh acquisition in 2026, reflecting a faster M&A pace. Clutch Security focuses on protecting enterprise systems accessed by AI agents, a segment tied to emerging AI driven cyber risks.
